title: Smoky Bean Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy taco recipe featuring smoky beans, perfect for a quick dinner or snack.

ingredients.name: Canned black beans, drained and rinsed
Shredded cheese (optional)
ingredients.notes: Monterey Jack or Cheddar work well

instructions: In a medium pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the canned beans, taco seasoning, and hot sauce (if using).
Stir to combine, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
While the beans are cooking, prepare your tortillas by warming them in the oven or on a dry pan.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the bean mixture onto a tortilla, followed by any desired toppings.
